name: plastic
title: Plastic Orb
description: A glossy white plastic orb with soft studio reflections, on black.
useWhen: A hero object for a product intro, app icon moment or abstract title card.
A clean studio-lit 3D look with no 3D assets.
avoidWhen: You want an iridescent or metallic surface: use thin-film or holographic.
The orb must hold a logo or image: this one is a plain surface.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Diameter of the orb as a share of the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Gloss
variables.description: Sharpness and strength of the reflections.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
